script.title: Understanding the Life and Future Supernova of Betelgeuse
script.description: Explore the massive scale, evolutionary state, and eventual supernova fate of the red supergiant star Betelgeuse.

shots.narration: High up in the winter sky, this massive red star sits prominently within the constellation of Orion, dwarfing our own sun many times over.
Placing this massive star right where our sun resides would cause its outer layers to stretch far past the orbit of the planet Jupiter.
Deep inside, the fuel is nearly gone, meaning this aging giant will inevitably collapse and explode in a brilliant supernova within one hundred thousand years.
